g.text: V9: the public list is status = ACTIVE ONLY (auto-hidden shelters
are absent). The optional trust filter hasCapacity composes with
source (M11: the rating filter is gone - a stray param is ignored,
SELECT ... WHERE source IN (...) AND status = 'ACTIVE'
report counts by type + fresh occupancy (one batched pass - no N+1)
save shelter (status = ACTIVE, source = USER, created_by = user)
List<ShelterDto> (never other users' or registry rows)
[not the author (or a registry / legacy created_by-NULL row)]
bbox re-check (shared gate with POST) -> 400 outside Estonia
DELETE shelter (reports + occupancy cascade via the DB)
fetch(url) (one hop, NO auto-follow; 3 s connect / 5 s read, 10 s budget)
[pair extracted on the final URL (bbox gate + auto-swap)]
[invalid input / other host / no pair / outside Estonia]
502 ONE generic retry-later message (no upstream detail)
409 "This report has already been submitted" (no throttle budget consumed)
[type = NON_EXISTENT and the count goes 4 -> 5 (shelter ACTIVE, not disarmed)]
UPDATE shelters SET status = INACTIVE (auto-hide, exactly-once trigger)
[type = OPEN_CONFIRMED and the USER row is still review_status = NEW and reporter != submitter (V11)]
INSERT moderation_actions (AUTO_CONFIRM, actor = the reporting user)
The auto-hide is the ONLY auto-hide path. After a manual status change
(admin restore sets auto_hide_disarmed = true) later reports increment
the count but never re-hide. CLOSED / OPEN_CONFIRMED net to a display
CONFIRMED_OPEN, a tie counts as confirmed open) - they never hide.
V11: OPEN_CONFIRMED additionally carries the NEW -> CONFIRMED promotion
(community-review-queue v2 D2) - in the SAME transaction, audited
AUTO_CONFIRM; the submitter's own positive report never promotes.
UPSERT shelter_occupancy_reports (shelter_id, user_id) - latest band wins, updated_at refreshed
Occupancy is DISPLAY-ONLY: it never hides, recolors or filters. The read-time
derivation (GET /api/shelters*): fresh = updated_at within the last 2 h (checked
in SQL, no cleanup job); the most recent fresh band wins; reportCount = fresh
reports agreeing with it (1 = "Reported full" hedged, 2+ = "Full" firm);
13. Admin moderation (Bearer JWT + ADMIN kind - fresh lookup per request)
load the JWT's userId, check kind = ADMIN (fresh lookup, D2 - no JWT claim)
401 (the security entry point - /admin/** is in the authenticated set)
403 "Admin access required" (AdminAccessException - a demotion takes effect on this very request)
every shelter (ALL statuses incl. hidden) + the same batched trust pass as the public list (no N+1)
409 "Registry shelters are import-owned and cannot be moderated here"
UPDATE shelters SET auto_hide_disarmed = true, status = 'ACTIVE' ' the disarm is permanent (V9 D1)
UPDATE shelters SET review_status = 'NEW' ' it starts over - a rejected row does not come back as CONFIRMED
DELETE shelter (USER rows only - registry 409, absent 404; ON DELETE CASCADE -> shelter reports, occupancy, open-status)
UPDATE shelter_reports SET dismissed_at = now() (stamped ONCE - a re-dismiss is a no-op; the row is KEPT)
Queue: GET /admin/reports?shelterId= (newest first; the shelter's LIVE status +
the reporter's profile name/email - admin-only data, never exposed outside
/admin/*). Reporter identity is served from this API ONLY.
V11: EVERY action above (status change, delete, dismiss) writes its
moderation_actions audit row in the SAME transaction - see 13f/13g.
409 "Registry shelters are import-owned and cannot be moderated here"
400 (standard vocabulary - the reason is REQUIRED to reject)
UPDATE shelters SET review_status = 'CONFIRMED', review_note = NULL (status untouched - CONFIRM does not un-hide)
UPDATE shelters SET review_status = 'REJECTED', review_note = ?, status = 'INACTIVE' (the existing hide mechanism)
The rare manual fallback (community-review-queue v2 D2) - the PRIMARY promotion
path is automatic (the AUTO_CONFIRM in flow 10). A CONFIRM of an INACTIVE row
does NOT un-hide it - visibility is the status endpoint's job (13b).
SELECT ... FROM moderation_actions ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT ?
batched read-time joins: shelter names + moderator names (one lookup each - no N+1)
List<AdminAuditDto> ' a deleted shelter renders "Deleted shelter" (shelter_id is FK-free by design)
